answer:
Set promptfoo's concurrency limit to 1. This serializes evaluation, so providers run one at a time.

**In the config file** (`promptfooconfig.yaml`):

```yaml
evaluateOptions:
  maxConcurrency: 1
```

**On the command line:**

```powershell
promptfoo eval -j 1
```

`-j` is the short form of `--max-concurrency`. I'm fairly confident of this from my knowledge of promptfoo, but check `promptfoo eval --help` if the flag doesn't work with your version.

This limit applies to all test cases, not just providers, so every provider-and-test combination runs sequentially. I don't know of a setting that runs providers one at a time while keeping test cases in parallel. If you need to avoid rate limits, `evaluateOptions` also has a `delay` option (milliseconds between requests) that I believe you can combine with a concurrency limit, but I haven't verified that.
